rules.install:
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" make PREFIX="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" install
ln -sf bzdiff "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/bzcmp" ln -sf bzgrep "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/bzegrep" ln -sf bzgrep "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/bzfgrep" ln -sf bzmore "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/bzless"
rm "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/bzcat" "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/bzip2"
ln -sf bunzip2 "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/bzcat" ln -sf bunzip2 "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/bzip2"
